cohort: 68 women with placenta accreta spectrum referred to the Imam Khomeini hospital in Ahvaz, Iran, between March 2015 and February 2020
finding: There was no significant difference in outcomes between women with PAS who underwent hysterectomy compared to those who underwent uterine preservation surgery.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in outcomes between uterine preservation surgery and hysterectomy in women with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean section.
